asset.name: GenerationControls
asset.description: The coordinated control set for stop, continue, retry, regenerate, branch, edit, and resume, with accurate availability and honest pending state for each.

requires.reason: Actions and overflow use the shared group.
Each control is an async action button with real pending state.

rationale: Stop must actually stop and must acknowledge immediately. A stop control that stays pressed while tokens keep arriving is the clearest possible signal to a user that the interface is not in control of the system.
